g.text: SARA ANT and ANT_GNSS pads do not require restrict on layer 2 as the prepreg thickness is >= 200µm
Pull 3.3V_EN low to disable 3.3V power. Use a switch or an open-collector / open-drain output.
Be careful providing external 3.3V here as it may compete with the 3.3V regulator.
Switch JP2 from VCCIO to SARA GPIO2 to control power to the GNSS antenna
VCC: Min. 3.3V Typ. 3.8V Max. 4.4V VCC Extended: Min. 3.0V Max. 4.5V Maximum current draw during Tx: 395mA
Change jumper to reverse the direction of DSR for 2 UART communication
A <= B : DIR = GND A => B : DIR = VCCA
A <= B : DIR = GND A => B : DIR = VCCA
